title: Database connection-pool exhaustion
description: The service's DB connection pool is saturated; requests wait for a connection and time out.
reasoning: Database connection-pool exhaustion is ranked #1 with deterministic score 0.89. Supporting evidence: [E2] payment-service db connections active reached 100% of capacity (40/40); baseline 0%; [E3] payment-service db connections waiting increased from 0.00 → 8.68 (peak 27.00, from a ~zero baseline, z=8684210.5); [E1] payment-service db connection acquire ms increased from 0ms → 680ms (peak 2000ms, +3593986%, z=157402.5); [E10] 361 × ERROR on payment-service: "failed to acquire database connection after <measure> (pool=<num>/<num>, waiting=<num>)" — new (absent from baseline).

remediation.title: Roll back the most recent deployment
remediation.description: If the pool pressure started after a deploy, rolling back restores the previous concurrency profile.

remediation.title: Reduce transaction concurrency
remediation.description: Lower worker/transaction concurrency so demand fits the pool ceiling.

remediation.title: Raise the pool ceiling after validating DB capacity
remediation.description: Only after confirming the database can hold more connections.

remediation.title: Alert on connection-acquisition latency
remediation.description: Add a leading-indicator alert on db_connection_acquire_ms.

title: Regression introduced by a deployment
description: Errors begin immediately after a version change with no infrastructure signal.
reasoning: Regression introduced by a deployment is ranked #2 with deterministic score 0.38. Supporting evidence: [E13] deployment payment-service 2.8.0 → 2.8.1 completed 0 min after onset; commit 5906c789 "increase transaction concurrency from 8 to 64 for faster checkout"; touches payment/db/pool.py, payment/checkout/worker.py; [E14] deployment payment-service 2.8.1 → 2.8.2 completed 0 min after onset; commit 1b933837 "increase transaction concurrency from 8 to 64 for faster checkout"; touches payment/db/pool.py, payment/checkout/worker.py; [E4] payment-service http error rate increased from 0.0% → 46.3% (peak 100.0%, from a ~zero baseline, z=462603.9); [E15] payment-service is the only service in scope with a deployment in the last 30 minutes. Contradicting evidence: [E2] payment-service db connections active reached 100% of capacity (40/40); baseline 0%.

remediation.title: Roll back to the previous version
remediation.description: Fastest path to recovery for a code regression.

remediation.title: Review the deploy diff for the failing code path
